newsitem.title: UK: UK rejects market testing of Treasury forecasting.
newsitem.headline: UK rejects market testing of Treasury forecasting.

text.p: The government has rejected the idea of subjecting the economic forecasting function of the Treasury to market testing, Chancellor of the Exchequer Gordon Brown said on Tuesday.
Consultants KPMG Management Consulting were asked earlier this year by the previous Conservative government to look into the possibility of market testing of the function.
But Brown said in a written parliamentary answer that KPMG had concluded that "in this case market testing would not lead to savings".

Brown said he accepted this advice, but would ask his official to pursue suggestions made by KPMG for "possible internal reforms designed to use Treasury forecasting staff more flexibly". -- London Newsroom +44 171 5427767
